newsitem.title: UK: UniChem tells Gehe "get on and bid".
newsitem.headline: UniChem tells Gehe "get on and bid".

text.p: Jeffery Harris, chief executive of UniChem called on Gehe to launch an offer for Lloyds Chemists.

"Gehe have been making these comments consistently over the past few months. There is nothing new in what they are saying. If they want to buy Lloyds they should get on and bid and then let the market decide," said Harris in a statement.
German pharmeceutical wholesaler Gehe said earlier it is evaluating its position after UniChem renewed its bid for Lloyds Chemists and added that it is still interested in acquiring Lloyds.
Gehe also questioned UniChem's claim that its acquisition of Lloyds will enhance earnings after the first 12 months.
In a statement to the London stock exchange Gehe asked if UniChem had the experience to integrate Lloyds Chemists effectively and questioned the consistency of UniChem's recent statements.
